The top right money box now draws one layout only. This shipped as v35.01 (`fa3ab4f83`), and the gate passed, including the seed 4242 fingerprint.

**Cause.** The old page-text copy of the wallet is hidden only while the canvas rows were drawn in the last 200 ms. The rows were stamped with the real clock, but the loop passed its own frame time to the hide check. The camera staging for his photo (gfx-b-machine-damage) drives the loop with frame times several seconds ahead of the real clock, so the page text came back and printed over the rows. In real play the frame time and the real clock agree, so this was a camera-staging artifact, not a bug a player would have seen.

**Fix.** `trHide` now reads the same real clock as the rows. His canvas rows are unchanged. The new check fails on v34.78 and passes now. It calls `trHide` with a time 5 seconds ahead of the real clock and asserts the page text stays hidden. It tests that clock mismatch directly, not the full gfx-b-machine-damage recipe.
